metadata.description: Performs a structured review of code, identifying positives, issues, and suggestions for improvement. Can decompose into specific review aspects if needed.

instances.instructions: Review the code. If the code files are too complex, you may need to decompose the task in smaller parts, like per function or per module. Structured review format: positives, issues (severity: low/medium/high), suggestions.
instances.instructions_final: Review the code. Structured review format: positives, issues (severity: low/medium/high), suggestions.
